meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 收到 Bug 报告后，Claude 会复制相关代码到临时目录，重现问题，用测试确认问题存在，做最小修复并验证。之后：LazyCodex 相关缺陷提交带补丁的 issue；Codex 官方缺陷开 fork PR。最后清理临时文件。
howto.when: 当你说“修复这个 bug”“贡献修复”“给 bug 开 PR”等，或要求调试并修复 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复 LazyCodex 的 marketplace 同步 bug。
调试 openai/codex 的 init 报错，并开 PR。
say.note: Claude 会复现、修复并从 fork 发起 PR。

say.text: omo-codex 的 hook 有 bug，请修复。
say.note: Claude 会验证后提交修复 issue。

howto.what_en: On a bug report, Claude copies the project to a temp dir, reproduces, writes a failing test, fixes minimally, and verifies. LazyCodex-related: files an issue with patch; upstream Codex: opens fork PR. Then cleans up.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'fix a bug', 'contribute a fix', 'open a PR', etc., or when you ask to debug and submit a fix for a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Help me fix the marketplace sync bug in LazyCodex.
say_en.note: Claude will file an issue with a patch on the lazycodex repo.

say_en.text: Debug the init error in openai/codex and open a PR.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces, fixes, and opens a PR from a fork.

say_en.text: The omo-codex hook has a bug; please fix it.
say_en.note: Claude verifies and files a fix issue.
